family.description: This domain is N-terminal in outer membrane protein SusF from Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron and similar sequences from bacteroidetes. SusF is a starch-binding protein organised into three tandem domains packed against each other: N-terminal (this entry), middle, and C-terminal. The last two, represented by [pfam:PF16411], are common to SusE and SusF. This domain forms a beta-sandwich that is similar in overall-fold and topology to several immunoglobulin superfamily domains found in cell adhesion proteins [[cite:PUB00062486]].
family.name: Outer membrane protein SusF, N-terminal domain
